For my sister

I made you something

Since September 14

My Home Girl,
My Sister

We have never met in person. We found each other online not long ago, and she already feels like family to me.

How it started

It all began on September 14. That is the day our paths crossed online, and honestly I did not expect much from it. You never really know when a random conversation is going to turn into something that matters. But from the very first days, talking to her felt easy, like I did not have to try or pretend to be anyone other than myself.

Some people spend years looking for someone they truly click with. With her it happened almost instantly. I know it has not been very long, and I know some people would laugh at the idea of calling someone a sister after such a short time. But feelings do not follow a calendar, and what I feel for her is completely real.

Why she feels like a sister

She is one of those rare people who makes you comfortable right away. There is a warmth in the way she talks and a kindness that comes through even across a screen. When we chat, it feels like she genuinely cares about what I am saying, and that is not something you find every day in a world where everyone is distracted and only half listening.

Every single picture of her has its own mood.

Online does not mean less real

Our friendship lives in messages, calls and pictures, and some people act like that makes it less real. I completely disagree. The care I feel for her is not fake just because it arrives through a screen. Someone thinking of you, checking in and making time for you is real, no matter how far apart you are.

I do not know exactly what the future holds, but I really hope that one day we get to meet, hug for real, and laugh about how it all started on one random day in September.

My sister, in every mood and every light.

Thank you

Thank you for being kind to me, for talking to me, and for letting me call you my sister. I have only known you for a short time, but you have already earned a permanent place in my heart. This is just the beginning, and I am really looking forward to everything that comes next.

Love you, sis

Sis, no matter how far apart we are, you will always have a place in my heart. You deserve all the love, happiness and good things this world has to offer, and I will always be here cheering for you, supporting you and thinking of you. Thank you for being exactly who you are. I am so lucky to have you.
